h:
最后，一个一致的角色姿势的解决方案！

只需输入任何你想要的角色和姿势你希望他们表演，仅此而已。

我给出的例子并不是精心挑选的。我已经测试了 30 次，它们都完全满足了我的要求。

在等待的同时广域网2.1要发布具有 ControlNet 支持的图像到图像模型，我的工作流程目前是实现这一目标的最佳替代方案人物姿势一致.

比 Flux Kontext 更好、更快。

在具有 16GB VRAM 的 A4000 GPU 上，大约需要40至50秒生成3 张图片.

我在工作流程中使用的最快 wan2.1 模型的链接：https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/Wan2.1_T2V_14B_LightX2V_StepCfgDistill_VACE-GGUF/tree/main

免责声明1：我使用的是非常优化的 Wan2.1 vace 模型，如果你看一下生成设置，我只使用了 4 个步骤和 1 个 cfg。如果您想使用自己的Wan2.1 vac模型，使用最适合您的模型的设置来增加这些设置。但我强烈推荐下载我链接的那个，因为它超级快！

万2.1 vae：https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/tree/main/split_files/vae

免责声明2：如果您遇到 triton/torch/cuda 错误，请绕过 torchcompileModelwanVideoV2 节点，然后在 comfy 管理器中“更新全部”，然后重新启动。

我正在使用的剪辑模型：https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors

我使用的姿势：https://civitai.com/models/22214/openposes-collection（并且ofc使用你自己的姿势）

现在您只需使用一张参考图像创建一个洛拉为了你的性格，
或者当您有这样的工作流程时，为什么还要费心使用 LoRA？

o.en:
Finally, a Solution for Consistent Character Posing!

Simply inputany character you wantand theposesyou want them to perform, and that's it.

The examples I gave aren't cherry picked. I've tested it like 30 times and they all give me exactly what I asked for.

While waiting forWAN 2.1to release an image-to-image model with ControlNet support, my workflow is currently the best alternative for achievingconsistent character poses.

Better and much faster than Flux Kontext.

On a A4000 gpu with 16GB VRAM, it takes around40 to 50 secondsto generate3 images.

Link for the fastest wan2.1 model that I'm using in my workflow:https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/Wan2.1_T2V_14B_LightX2V_StepCfgDistill_VACE-GGUF/tree/main

Disclaimer1: I'm using a very optimized Wan2.1 vace model, if you look at the generation setting, I'm using only 4 steps and 1 cfg.If you want to use your own Wan2.1 vace model, increase those setting with whatever works best for your model. But Ihighly recommend downloadingthe one I linked because it's super fast!

Wan 2.1 vae :https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/tree/main/split_files/vae

Disclaimer2: if you're getting triton/torch/cuda erros, bypass the torchcompileModelwanVideoV2 Node, then "update all" in comfy manager, then restart.

The clip model I'm using :https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors

Poses I used:https://civitai.com/models/22214/openposes-collection(and ofc use your own poses)

Now you can use justone reference imageto create aLoRAfor your character,
or why even bother with a LoRA when you have this workflow?
